definitions.short: Delajah , the name of five Israelites
definitions.full: H1806. Delayah or Delayahu דְּלָיָה דְּלָיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( Yah(u) hath drawn ) — 1 דְּלָיָהוּ , a. a priest, contemporary of David , 1Chr 24:18 . b. a prince of Judah , contemporary of Jeremiah Jer 36:12 , 25 . 2 דְּלָיָה , a. head of a family contemporary with Zerubbabel Ezra 2:60 = Neh 7:62 . b. descendant of Zerubbabel . 1Chr 3:24 . c. father of contemporary of Nehemiah Neh 6:10 .
definitions.rootNote: or (prolonged) דְּלָיָהוּ xlit Dᵉlâyâhhûw corrected to Dᵉlâyâhûw ; from 1802 and 3050 ; Jah has delivered;
